markets.title: Markets
markets.intro: Where this style is sold. For goods going to a market it is sold in, the gates check that market's languages.
markets.everyMeans: None picked: it is sold everywhere, as before. The language rules for every market wait at the gates until a market is picked here.
markets.listMeans: For goods going to these markets, the gates ask for the DoC, the user information and the label in each market's languages. Goods going elsewhere are not refused for that.
markets.notOffered: no longer offered: it can only be taken off
markets.pickEvery: Nothing ticked: sold in every market.
markets.pickLegend: The markets this style's company sells in
markets.pickMeans: The markets and their languages are kept in Compliance › Rules & markets. A switched-off market's own rules wait until it is on.

held.failed: The markets could not be read: try again first.
held.noRight: Your role cannot change where a style is sold.
held.offline: Offline: the markets change when the connection is back.
held.everyAlready: Nothing is ticked: it is already every market.

refusal.EDIT_BLOCKED: Nothing of this style changes in its lifecycle state (its edit rule in Product settings is "blocked"): move it to another state first.
refusal.STYLE_ARCHIVED: The style is archived: reactivate it before changing where it is sold.
refusal.other: Where this style is sold does not change now.

problem.moved: Someone changed the style meanwhile: the markets were read again. Pick again.
problem.changed: A market changed meanwhile: the markets were read again. Pick again.
problem.market: A market can no longer be added (archived, removed or another company's): the markets were read again.
problem.invalid: The list was not accepted: the markets were read again. Pick again.
problem.forbidden: Your role cannot change where this style is sold.
problem.gone: This style is no longer there.
problem.failed: The markets were not saved: try again.
problem.readForbidden: Your role does not read where this style is sold.
problem.readFailed: The markets could not be read.

templates.hint: The measures a made-to-measure style of this type takes. Its made-to-measure rules stay off until they are started per template.
templates.failed: The measurement templates could not be read: the type keeps what it names.
templates.none: No active measurement template of this kind of garment for this company yet.
